ios.desc:
Mindfuse is voice chat with real people worldwide: a voice-only app that connects you one-to-one with someone anywhere in the world, with no profile and no photos. Tap once, meet someone new in another city or on another continent, and just talk. Hear the person, not the profile.

Our mission is creating a greater sense of community, one conversation at a time.

ONE OF A KIND WEAVE ART, FOR EVERYONE
After every conversation, the two voices become a Weave: an artwork in its own style, made from how you talked, never from what was said. No two Weaves are ever the same, and every one is yours to keep. Free or member, every conversation becomes one of a kind art. Share it, or keep it in your world.

HOW IT WORKS
• Verify your phone number and confirm you are 18 or older
• Tap once and Mindfuse looks for someone new to talk to, somewhere in the world
• Talk for as long as you both like, then end the call whenever you choose
• Receive your Weave, and watch your world grow with every conversation

WHY A VOICE CALL
A voice call with someone new feels different from texting. There is no camera to perform for and no profile to judge. You hear tone, warmth, laughter and the pause before someone says something real. Many people find a voice conversation gets somewhere real faster than text or video.

PEOPLE AROUND THE WORLD
Every call is a chance to talk to people around the world: hear how a day looks somewhere else, swap stories, or simply enjoy a friendly voice. If you want to make friends around the world without swiping through faces, this is a calmer way to start.

THE DAILY FUSE
Every day at 17:00 UTC the community comes online together for the Daily Fuse. It is the easiest moment to find someone to talk to, wherever you are.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN, ACCOUNTABLE BY DESIGN
• No profiles, names or photos are shown to the people you talk to
• Every member is phone-verified and 18+
• Report or block anyone, right from the call
• Calls are not recorded. A Weave is drawn from how loud each voice was moment to moment, never from audio or words

THE OFFER
• Your first two weeks are free
• After that, enjoy 3 free conversations every week
• Premium: unlimited conversations, 12 places in your world and a patron mark on your Weaves, priced for your country
• Founding Member: Premium for life with one payment, with 21 places in your world and a gold Founding patron mark

Members keep Mindfuse open for everyone who talks for free.

Talk to someone who sees the world differently.

quotes.text:
Most consumer apps today don’t serve the user.
They serve engagement loops, ad models, or vanity metrics.

But what if the next generation of software didn’t optimize for time spent?
What if it optimized for human well-being?

Not "digital detox." Not "go outside."
I mean actual tools—designed with intention—that help us:

Think more clearly

Connect more deeply

Escape compulsive use loops

Have conversations instead of perform for attention

Use tech without feeling like it’s using us

We’ve normalized design patterns that train the brain like a slot machine.
But what happens when we start building tech that trains for presence, not addiction?

It seems like the next wave won’t be “anti-tech,” but pro-conscious-tech.
Thoughtful systems, not just minimal ones.
Fewer dopamine traps. More signal. More silence. More agency.
Sub: https://www.reddit.com/r/Mindfuse_app/
Website: https://mindfuse.io/our-story
Appstore: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/mindfuse/id6476620258

Most social platforms are built around engagement metrics—feeds, likes, comments, algorithms. They're designed to keep us consuming, not connecting.

I wanted something different. Mindfuse is a space for anonymous, one-on-one audio conversations with people from around the world. No profiles, no feeds, no endless content—just real, spontaneous human connection.

It's for people who actually like talking, learning, and exchanging perspectives. A quiet alternative to the noise.

Still experimental, still raw, but it works—and some of the conversations I’ve had here have been better than anything on social media.

You can try it on the App Store (iOS only for now). I’d love feedback from this community.

iOS link: https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/mindfuse/id6476620258
